""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. tags immediately after function definitions, which we currently ignore # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.40 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.325) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Removing the 20-function limit will increase completeness by capturing all available functions # MECHANISM-2: The arbitrary limit of 20 functions artificially caps our extraction, preventing full documentation coverage # EXPECT-2: completeness > 0.45 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.325) # HYPOTHESIS-3: Deduplicating functions by name will improve accuracy by eliminating redundant entries from multiple extraction methods # MECHANISM-3: Our three extraction approaches often find the same function multiple times, inflating counts without adding value # EXPECT-3: accuracy > 0.78 # RESULT-3: REFUTED (actual=0.7222222222222222) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions_dict = {} # Use dict to deduplicate by name # 1. Look for dt/dd pairs (common in Sphinx docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig") for block in dt_blocks: sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) signature = block.get_text(strip=True) # Look for description in next dd element dd = block.find_next_sibling("dd") description = dd.get_text(strip=True)[:200] if dd else "No description" functions_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), } # 2. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name not in functions_dict: # Find description in parent or next sibling parent = block.parent desc = parent.find_next("p") description = desc.get_text(strip=True)[:200] if desc else "No description" functions_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 3. Look for h3 headers with function signatures h3_blocks = soup.find_all("h3") for block in h3_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name not in functions_dict: # Get description from next paragraph desc = block.find_next("p") description = desc.get_text(strip=True)[:200] if desc else "No description" functions_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": description, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(functions_dict.values()) # Return all unique functions def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Handle both comma-separated and newline-separated parameters param_parts = re.split(r'[,\n]', param_string) for part in param_parts: part = part.strip() if part and part not in ['...', '*', '**']: # Extract name, handling type annotations name_part = part.split("=")[0].split(":")[0].strip() # Remove leading * or ** name_part = name_part.lstrip('*').strip() if name_part: params.append({ "name": name_part, "type": "unknown", "default": None, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
